title: Ācyapadi Haim action reading and the unmerged Pāṇinian variant
predecessor_review: PG633 retained Vasu128 parenthetical ācyapadi as an actual unresolved candidate while K has āḍhyapadi; PG637 kept the candidate Open. The Haim witnesses now provide a positive action reading and inner derivation in a different grammatical tradition. No K/Vasu token, generic128ic rule or older āḍhyapadi interface is corrected or recredited.
tradition: Haim/Hemacandra witness; not silently transferred into the Pāṇinian K text

frames.compound: fixed action expression admitted by the Haim gaṇa
frames.final_member: pāda→pad on the source-specific outer route
frames.meaning: lies after stretching/reaching the two feet

records: two feet are the inner action participants
śete is the external event predicate
inner ā+añc105 carries the source-tradition absolutive request
no finite pada or voice is assigned to the inner nonfinite form
root ID belongs to the Haim namespace, not Pāṇini dhātu-data numbering
outer ācyapadi modifies the lying event in the quoted usage
the fixed source action reading does not license arbitrary āḍhya/ācya interchange

source_observations: Haim Prakash explicitly pairs ācyapādau with ācyapadi śete
Dhundika identifies Haim root105 ā+añc, nonfinite replacement and stretch/reach interpretation

source_policy.adopted: Admit ācyapadi as a positive Haim-tradition fixed action adverb with inner ā+añc105 and the quoted lying event; keep its source namespace on every operator/history state.
source_policy.boundary: Do not emend Pāṇinian K āḍhyapadi, normalize VCP Adyapadi, or treat Haim rule numbers/root IDs as Pāṇinian addresses.
